_meta.description: Seed katalog aturan anomali config K8s/CI untuk fitur `bq --anomaly-scan` (future). Dirancang untuk collection PocketBase `build_q_anomaly_rules`. Setiap record = 1 rule yang akan dikirim ke Jev sebagai criteria dalam questions multi-choice (severity + violations).

severity_scale.critical: Blocker — menyebabkan outage, security breach, atau build/deploy gagal total.
severity_scale.warn: Non-blocker tapi melanggar standar; perlu dibenahi dlm siklus berikutnya.
severity_scale.info: Observasi; bisa jadi intentional. Hanya catatan untuk review.

category_glossary.availability: replica, HPA, PDB, probes — ketahanan saat node/pod disturbance
category_glossary.security: secret plaintext, privileged, runAsRoot, hostNetwork, sops-leak
category_glossary.compliance: production standards (replicas>=2 + HPA + PDB), label mandatory
category_glossary.config_drift: image tag mismatch gitops↔cluster, kustomize override stale
category_glossary.build: Dockerfile, compose, cicd.json, Makefile config issue
category_glossary.cicd: Jenkins X / Lighthouse / webhook pipeline misconfig
category_glossary.network: Service selector, NodePort conflict, Ingress TLS/host

build_q_anomaly_rules.description: Deployment di namespace production-* dengan replicas < 2 — risiko downtime saat satu pod evicted/restart.
build_q_anomaly_rules.fix_hint: Set spec.replicas = 2 (atau lebih). Standar pdb-production-standards. Perbaiki via `bq --bootstrap-k8s ... --replicas 2`.

build_q_anomaly_rules.description: Deployment tanpa imagePullSecrets: regcred — image private akan ImagePullBackOff.
build_q_anomaly_rules.detect_hint: spec.template.spec.imagePullSecrets missing OR not containing regcred
build_q_anomaly_rules.fix_hint: Tambah imagePullSecrets: [{name: regcred}]. Standar Qoin. `bq --bootstrap-k8s` auto-inject.

build_q_anomaly_rules.description: spec.selector.matchLabels drift dari namespace suffix — selector K8s IMMUTABLE, deployment lama harus dihapus dulu untuk recreate.
build_q_anomaly_rules.fix_hint: `bq --bootstrap-k8s ... --force-recreate-deploy` (refuse di production tanpa kube-context eksplisit).

build_q_anomaly_rules.description: Container image memakai tag `:latest` — rollback impossible, non-deterministic deploy.
build_q_anomaly_rules.detect_hint: containers[].image ends with ':latest' OR tag absent
build_q_anomaly_rules.fix_hint: Pin ke tag versi (v1.2.3) atau commit sha. Gunakan `bq --gitops-set-image`.

build_q_anomaly_rules.description: ArgoCD source.kustomize.images override tag drift dari _deployment.yaml di GitOps — menyebabkan OutOfSync persistent.
build_q_anomaly_rules.fix_hint: `gitops-audit <ns> --strip-overrides` (fix permanen → pure GitOps), atau `--apply` kalau newTag lebih baru.

build_q_anomaly_rules.description: CCE deployment nodeSelector cce.cloud.com/cce-nodepool TIDAK match pattern `<ctx>-nodepool-{manager|service}` per NODEPOOL.md.
build_q_anomaly_rules.fix_hint: `bq --bootstrap-k8s ... --nodepool <explicit>`. Cek NODEPOOL.md untuk mapping per cluster/namespace.

build_q_anomaly_rules.description: SLS deployment nodeSelector `nodetype` bukan front|back — pod akan Pending (unschedulable).
build_q_anomaly_rules.fix_hint: Set nodetype sesuai service tier. Standar sls-pro-* via skill gitops-k8s-bootstrap.

build_q_anomaly_rules.description: Deployment production tanpa HorizontalPodAutoscaler — melanggar pdb-production-standards (wajib replicas>=2 + HPA + PDB).
build_q_anomaly_rules.detect_hint: No HPA with scaleTargetRef pointing to deployment in namespace production-*
build_q_anomaly_rules.fix_hint: Generate HPA via `bq --bootstrap-k8s` (auto-produce HPA untuk env=production). Target CPU 70% default.

build_q_anomaly_rules.description: Deployment production tanpa PodDisruptionBudget — risiko semua pod evicted saat drain node.
build_q_anomaly_rules.detect_hint: No PDB with selector matching deployment labels in production-*
build_q_anomaly_rules.fix_hint: Generate PDB (minAvailable: 1 untuk replicas 2, atau 50%). `bq --bootstrap-k8s` auto-produce.

build_q_anomaly_rules.description: HPA minReplicas == maxReplicas — tidak ada autoscale, HPA jadi dekorasi.
build_q_anomaly_rules.fix_hint: Set maxReplicas minimal 2x minReplicas, atau hapus HPA kalau memang static.

build_q_anomaly_rules.description: PDB minAvailable: 0 — tidak memberi perlindungan apa pun saat node drain.
build_q_anomaly_rules.fix_hint: Ganti ke minAvailable: 1 (atau 50% untuk replicas>=4).

build_q_anomaly_rules.description: .NET: key secret `appsettings.{Env}.json` tidak match runtime env (DOTNET_ENVIRONMENT / --environment= / ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT) di Deployment — menyebabkan config diabaikan → CrashLoopBackOff exit 139.
build_q_anomaly_rules.detect_hint: Secret.data key suffix != deployment env (develop-qoin → Develop.json? Develop vs develop case!)
build_q_anomaly_rules.fix_hint: Pakai `bq` secret-from-file (ada validasi env matching) atau cek skill `file-config-setup`. Case harus EXACT match.

build_q_anomaly_rules.description: Base64 secret berisi BOM UTF-8 (EF BB BF di awal) — .NET System.Text.Json akan JsonException: '0xEF' is invalid start of a value.
build_q_anomaly_rules.fix_hint: Strip BOM saat generate secret (`sed -i '1s/^\xEF\xBB\xBF//'`). Skill `secret-from-file` auto-strip + round-trip verify.

build_q_anomaly_rules.description: .NET deployment tanpa volume mount `/app/appsettings.{env}.json` dari Secret file-config-* — config tidak terbaca.
build_q_anomaly_rules.detect_hint: containers[].volumeMounts does not include mountPath /app/appsettings.{env}.json AND stack=dotnet
build_q_anomaly_rules.fix_hint: Tambah volumes[].secret.secretName: file-config-<app> + volumeMounts[].mountPath: /app/appsettings.<Env>.json + subPath. Skill `file-config-setup` auto-patch.

build_q_anomaly_rules.description: SOPS encrypted file berada dalam ArgoCD source path — ArgoCD gagal unmarshal (ComparisonError), app Degraded.
build_q_anomaly_rules.detect_hint: ArgoCD source.path contains *.sops.yaml OR file with sops: block
build_q_anomaly_rules.fix_hint: Pindahkan SOPS file keluar dari source path, atau pakai argocd-vault-plugin. Lihat skill `argocd-sops-troubleshoot`.

build_q_anomaly_rules.description: Secret unencrypted (bukan SOPS, bukan Sealed) di-commit ke repo gitops — kredensial exposed.
build_q_anomaly_rules.detect_hint: Secret manifest tanpa field sops.* AND stringData/data bukan base64 placeholder
build_q_anomaly_rules.fix_hint: `bq --sops-encrypt <file>` — standar v0.1.39. Rotate credential yang bocor.

build_q_anomaly_rules.description: env.value berisi password/token/apikey plaintext (bukan env.valueFrom.secretKeyRef).
build_q_anomaly_rules.fix_hint: Pindah ke Secret + valueFrom.secretKeyRef. Rotate kredensial.

build_q_anomaly_rules.description: securityContext.privileged: true — container punya akses full host, security blast radius luas.
build_q_anomaly_rules.fix_hint: Hapus kecuali ada justifikasi tertulis (mis. CNI daemon). Prefer capabilities drop/add granular.

build_q_anomaly_rules.description: hostNetwork: true — pod share network namespace host, bypass Service abstraction + port conflict risk.
build_q_anomaly_rules.fix_hint: Hapus kecuali DaemonSet infrastruktur (ingress, CNI). App business services never need this.

build_q_anomaly_rules.description: Container tanpa livenessProbe — crashloop silent, kubelet tidak bisa auto-restart saat deadlock.
build_q_anomaly_rules.fix_hint: Tambah livenessProbe (httpGet /health atau exec script). Standar Qoin: path /health port <PORT>.

build_q_anomaly_rules.description: Container tanpa readinessProbe — Service forward traffic ke pod yang belum siap → 502/503 di rolling update.
build_q_anomaly_rules.fix_hint: Tambah readinessProbe (httpGet /health atau tcpSocket). Mandatory untuk zero-downtime deploy.

build_q_anomaly_rules.description: Container tanpa resources.limits — bisa pakai habis node resources (noisy neighbor), kena OOMKill tak terprediksi.
build_q_anomaly_rules.fix_hint: Set resources.requests + resources.limits.cpu/memory. Baseline: 100m/128Mi req, 500m/512Mi limit.

build_q_anomaly_rules.description: Service.spec.selector tidak match pod labels manapun — endpoints kosong, traffic drop.
build_q_anomaly_rules.detect_hint: No pod in namespace with labels matching Service.spec.selector
build_q_anomaly_rules.fix_hint: Sinkronkan selector dgn deployment template labels. Cross-check `kubectl get endpoints`.

build_q_anomaly_rules.description: NodePort yang sama dipakai Service lain di cluster — Service kedua gagal create.
build_q_anomaly_rules.detect_hint: Multiple Services with same spec.ports[].nodePort in cluster
build_q_anomaly_rules.fix_hint: Pilih port lain atau cutover (hapus service lama dulu). Skill `k8s-manifest-fix` ada cutover guide.

build_q_anomaly_rules.description: Service.ports[].targetPort tidak dideklarasikan sebagai containerPort di Deployment.
build_q_anomaly_rules.fix_hint: Samakan port atau beri name port (named port lebih robust saat refactor).

build_q_anomaly_rules.description: Ingress public (host *.qoin.id) tanpa spec.tls — traffic plaintext.
build_q_anomaly_rules.detect_hint: Ingress with public host AND spec.tls missing/empty
build_q_anomaly_rules.fix_hint: Konfigurasi cert-manager + spec.tls.secretName. Enforce HTTPS via annotation.

build_q_anomaly_rules.description: Dua Ingress claim host+path yang sama — behavior undefined, routing collision.
build_q_anomaly_rules.detect_hint: Multiple Ingress with overlapping (host, path) tuples
build_q_anomaly_rules.fix_hint: Audit dan merge atau pilih prefix path yang unik. Cek `kubectl get ing -A`.

build_q_anomaly_rules.description: ENV declaration sebelum FROM — Dockerfile syntax invalid, build gagal immediate.
build_q_anomaly_rules.detect_hint: First ENV line appears before first FROM line
build_q_anomaly_rules.fix_hint: Pindah ENV setelah FROM. `bq --fix-dockerfile` menangani migrasi legacy.

build_q_anomaly_rules.description: FROM memakai literal placeholder `REGISTRY01/PROJECT/...` — template unreplaced, pull gagal.
build_q_anomaly_rules.fix_hint: Replace dengan registry path aktual (loyaltolpi/...) atau ARG REGISTRY + build-arg.

build_q_anomaly_rules.description: Dockerfile FROM golang:X.Y tapi go.mod `go X.Z` — bisa fail bila mod butuh fitur Go versi lebih baru.
build_q_anomaly_rules.detect_hint: FROM golang:A.B AND go.mod declares go C.D with (A.B) < (C.D)
build_q_anomaly_rules.fix_hint: Sinkronkan FROM golang:<version> dgn go.mod. Pakai golang:1.25-alpine untuk release Go terbaru.

build_q_anomaly_rules.description: RUN go mod tidy / go build gagal karena private repo path pakai bitbucket (deprecated) alih-alih github — Authentication failed.
build_q_anomaly_rules.detect_hint: GOPRIVATE/go.mod references bitbucket.org/qoin* OR legacy path
build_q_anomaly_rules.fix_hint: Migrate ke github.com/Qoin-Digital-Indonesia/*. Set GOPRIVATE + inject GITHUB_USER/TOKEN via `--gh-auth` atau buildx --secret.

build_q_anomaly_rules.description: cicd.json tanpa field IMAGE — `bq` tidak bisa derive image name, build gagal.
build_q_anomaly_rules.fix_hint: Tambah "IMAGE": "<repo-name>" (biasanya sama dgn repo). `bq --init-jx` auto-generate.

build_q_anomaly_rules.description: cicd.json tanpa field PORT — template Deployment containerPort kosong.
build_q_anomaly_rules.fix_hint: Tambah "PORT": <int>. Harus match EXPOSE di Dockerfile dan listen port aplikasi.

build_q_anomaly_rules.description: Makefile ref `cicd/cicd/cicd.json` (double cicd) — baca config fail saat make build.
build_q_anomaly_rules.fix_hint: Ganti ke `cicd/cicd.json` saja. `bq --pr-fix` auto-perbaiki (regen Makefile).

build_q_anomaly_rules.description: compose.yaml service tanpa build: ATAU image: — `docker compose up` tidak tahu harus apa.
build_q_anomaly_rules.fix_hint: Tambah build: {context: ., dockerfile: Dockerfile} atau image: <ref>. `bq --init-jx` scaffold ulang.

build_q_anomaly_rules.description: .env.{BRANCH} direfer compose tapi file tidak ada → build fail (env_file not found).
build_q_anomaly_rules.detect_hint: env_file: '.env.*' AND file missing in context
build_q_anomaly_rules.fix_hint: Generate .env.{branch} dari PocketBase (bq pb-pull) atau commit template .env.example.

build_q_anomaly_rules.description: File .github/workflows/trigger-ci.yml masih ada — standar Fase 3 sekarang webhook cicd-hw.qoin.id/hook. Legacy action redundant.
build_q_anomaly_rules.fix_hint: Hapus file + verifikasi webhook aktif. `bq --pr-fix` auto-cleanup, lalu `bq --cicd-webhook` verify.

build_q_anomaly_rules.description: ArgoCD Application OutOfSync > 24 jam — biasanya kustomize image override stale atau manual kubectl edit.
build_q_anomaly_rules.fix_hint: Jalankan `gitops-audit` untuk cek drift override. Hard-refresh app via `argocd-app`.

build_q_anomaly_rules.description: Image tag di cluster (live Deployment) berbeda dengan di repo GitOps _deployment.yaml — ada manual patch atau sync gagal.
build_q_anomaly_rules.detect_hint: kubectl deployment image != gitops yaml image (same resource)
build_q_anomaly_rules.fix_hint: `bq --is-match-image <ns> <deploy> <gitops-repo> <branch> <path.yaml>` → kalau mismatch, sarankan `bq --gitops-set-image` untuk sync GitOps ke cluster.

build_q_anomaly_rules.description: kustomization.yaml tanpa `namespace:` — resource yang di-generate akan default ke namespace apply context (bahaya cross-env).
build_q_anomaly_rules.fix_hint: Tambah `namespace: <env>-<project>`. Harus match folder path (cce/<ns>/).

build_q_anomaly_rules.description: KrakenD partial endpoint backend host tidak match Service K8s di cluster — gateway 404/502.
build_q_anomaly_rules.fix_hint: Verifikasi via `apigw-check` (mock lokal). Pastikan host = <svc>.<ns>.svc.cluster.local:<port>.

build_q_anomaly_rules.description: KrakenD partial tidak set input_query_strings — query param (mis. ?value=) tidak diteruskan ke backend.
build_q_anomaly_rules.detect_hint: endpoints[].input_query_strings missing AND endpoint path has query
build_q_anomaly_rules.fix_hint: Tambah input_query_strings: ['value', ...] atau ['*']. Test via skill `apigw-check`.

build_q_anomaly_rules.description: metadata.name > 63 karakter — label values dibatasi 63 chars, pod template labels bisa truncated → selector mismatch.
build_q_anomaly_rules.fix_hint: Rename deployment lebih singkat. Hapus deployment lama (`--force-recreate-deploy` di non-prod).

build_q_anomaly_rules.description: File di `cce/staging-*/...yaml` tapi `metadata.namespace: production-*` (atau sebaliknya) — PR di-merge berarti apply ke env salah.
build_q_anomaly_rules.detect_hint: folder path env != metadata.namespace env prefix
build_q_anomaly_rules.fix_hint: Samakan namespace dgn folder, atau override via `--namespace` flag saat generate `bq --bootstrap-k8s`.

build_q_anomaly_rules.description: Deployment yang sama di develop/staging/production punya replicas tanpa pola (mis. prod=1, staging=3) — biasanya intentional, tapi flag untuk review.
build_q_anomaly_rules.detect_hint: same deployment name across envs with non-monotonic replicas (dev<=stg<=prod)
build_q_anomaly_rules.fix_hint: Review intent. Standar: dev=1, stg=1-2, prod>=2. Normalisasi via `bq --bootstrap-k8s`.

build_q_anomaly_rules.description: Image tag yang direfer di _deployment.yaml belum tersedia / belum READY di Docker Hub — PR merge → ArgoCD apply → ImagePullBackOff.
build_q_anomaly_rules.detect_hint: docker manifest inspect loyaltolpi/<repo>:<tag> fail OR not READY
build_q_anomaly_rules.fix_hint: Verifikasi via skill `gitops-check-image` sebelum PR merge. `bq --gitops-set-image` punya pre-flight image check.
